services.desc: At Hamilton Lakes Swim & Tennis Club, we provide our members with the highest quality, environmentally sensitive swim and tennis facilities in an inviting, relaxed family atmosphere. Nestled in the beautiful tree lined Hamilton Lakes community, the club is located at the intersection of Tower Road and Montpelier Drive in Greensboro, North Carolina. We are centrally located in between West Market Street and Friendly Avenue. Directions from West Market Street, turn north onto Muir’s Chapel and then right onto Tower Road.
